## Summary

[Partial] Locate specific wire locations and identify correct colors using a Digital MultiMeter to verify before making connections. [t2]

[Partial] Identify the relay's internal electromagnet switch that handles high current. [t11]

Use drawings and views to locate skid plate holes, verify flat stock placement, and note bend angles. [t179]

Locate the code on the display and cross-reference it to find the full descriptive name. [t287]

View the stock off-road light housing and use cardboard templates to map out the hole shape. [t1033]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use the diagrams as guidelines rather than blindly following them since they are just references. [t2]
- Note that 2011 models likely share the same wiring configuration as 2010. [t2]
- Note that bend angles are often relative to the preceding section rather than absolute. [t179]
- Check if hole dimensions include a specific diameter or just an approximate size (~4"). [t179]
- [Partial] Ignore page numbers in any accompanying Factory Service Manual if using these images instead, as they may not match your specific year's EC chapter exactly. [t287]
- Use cardboard templates to map out the hole shape before cutting metal [t1033]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Assuming the code name is identical to just the number without checking the descriptive title provided by this chart. [t287]
- [Partial] Using a 2011-era diagnostic list for a pre-2007 vehicle without verifying if the codes align with your specific year. [t287]
